title: Plink-Plonk Pebble Puffer
statement: Nestled among sun-dappled kelp and sunken basalt columns, this inquisitive little architect spends its days sorting translucent sea glass into intricate, ever-changing mosaics on the tank floor. Every so often, it drops a favored stone onto a hollow shell to test its chime, pulsing with soft bioluminescent ripples whenever a new pattern clicks into place.
